newsitem.title: Italy: MOTOR RACING-ITALY'S TRULLI TO DRIVE FOR MINARDI.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-ITALY'S TRULLI TO DRIVE FOR MINARDI.

text.p: Italian Jarno Trulli will partner Japan's Ukyo Katayama in the Minardi team for the 1997 world championship.

Minardi said on Monday that after allowing Italian Giancarlo Fisichella, who made his grand prix debut for them last year, to join Jordan, they decided to continue their policy of supporting emerging Italian talent.

"We decided to go for Jarno. He won the difficult German Formula Three championship, he performed very well when he tested the Benetton in Estoril last October, he's part of the family and Flavio (Briatore) had no objections to him racing for us," said team chief Gian Carlo Minardi.
Benetton boss Briatore joined former driver Alessandro Nannini and other international entrepreneurs last November in buying a 70 percent stake in Minardi.
Trulli, 22, began in karting as a nine-year-old and last season won the German title with Benetton's junior team.
Minardi announced last month that they had signed Katayama from Tyrrell.
Brazilian Tarso Marques will be Minardi's reserve driver.
